name: Auton Soldier
oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it isn't legendary, is an artifact in addition to its other types, and has myriad. (Whenever it attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, you may create a token copy that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. Exile the tokens at end of combat.)
blocked_sentences: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it isn't legendary, is an artifact in addition to its other types, and has myriad

needs.what: a `self_enters_as_copy` replacement whose `except_` grants a triggered ability (here myriad) as a copiable value -- e.g. `except_.keep_abilities` (indices of the printed card's own abilities, as `become_copy` already supports) or `except_.add_abilities` pointing at `grantable_abilities` -- so the copy has myriad alongside the copied creature's abilities
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `self_enters_as_copy`'s `except_` handles `remove_supertypes` and `add_types` (the other two clauses) but only adds abilities through `add_keywords`, and myriad is not in the keyword list -- it is written as a triggered ability (Herald of the Host, Blade of Selves). `keep_abilities` exists only on the `become_copy` op; the enters-as-copy path in zones.py resets `copying_own_abilities` to None. A `self_enters` trigger running `become_copy` would be a trigger rather than a 614.1b replacement, so the creature would briefly be a 0/0 and die before it resolves.
